mentions.name: Emurse
mentions.description: This is Emurse, a platform for teachers and educators to create their own language courses. It offers features similar to Babbel or Anki, plus unique features for phonetics study and customizing the learning experience. The team is working with language influencers to build courses on Emurse, including a Japanese Phonetics course created by YouTuber Dogen, and offers a free Thai reading course that can be previewed without an account.
mentions.problem: Making it easier to learn languages.
mentions.audience: Teachers and educators who create language courses, plus language learners.
mentions.source_excerpt: I am working on making it easier to learn languages. We provide a platform for teachers and educators to create their own language courses.  The platform offers features similar to software like Babel or Anki, along with some unique features for phonetics study and customizing the learning experience.
